items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: speaking of the guys having great respect for Alfred and his musical — I’m just going to say it, it’s true, genius. At the end of “Autumn Leaves,” Miles said to Alfred, “Is that what you wanted, Al?”

ctx.x: Well that came about only because they permitted Miles to be a sideman. Can you imagine Miles being a sideman? And so but Miles actually truly was the leader, but he did go ahead and do it. And if course it came out magnificently well. And speaking of the guys having great respect for Alfred and his musical — I’m just going to say it, it’s true, genius. At the end of “Autumn Leaves,” Miles said to Alfred, “Is that what you wanted, Al?” He knew he’d done it you know.
“Is that what you wanted, Al?” Interesting.
